Good games,

notes.title: [HotFix v0.1.1]
notes.content:
Dear Ka Mate players,

Thank you for your interest.

Ka Mate is a child of our long-suffering labor.

You can follow the improvements clicking  the link below.

Link: https://trello.com/b/ZRTOI1mE/ka-mate-public
 
Verified Discord server will be activated soon.  We will announce it.

With this update, we have fixed the bugs below.

-Graphics and sound settings can now be saved.

- We have fixed the bug in Save / Load.
- The animals that have been killed are now disappearing in a short time.
- The day / night cycle is now longer.

We will always be in touch with our players. Please don't hesitate to contact us.

We will develop Ka Mate together.

Best Regards,

2645Interactive Team.
